text:
marta: I'm assembling the release notes + changelog for the 'Routing & SDK parity' docs push. Key items: migration matrix for SDK method renames, anchors that moved in the Console docs, and a short Known Issues block. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7222 PTAL
ash: quick scan looks solid. two asks: (1) include a compact SDK remap table (old -> new) for Python/JS/Go, (2) call out that deep links/bookmarks may 404; we should add 301 redirects or ephemeral note for 24h after publish
marta: added a 3-row remap table and a "Bookmarks & redirects" paragraph recommending we provision short redirects and add a Console help banner for 48h. PTAL
lee: nit: the Python sample still shows `from redwood.sdk.v0 import Client`. update to `from redwood import Client` and add a short example of pinning a model variant using the Admin API
marta: fixed Python import and added an Admin API snippet for variant pinning (one-liner curl). Also added a tiny warmup example and a sentence about recommended warmup rates (5 RPS per GPU, ramp over 10 minutes)
ci-bot: snippet-tests queued
ci-bot: snippet-tests: JS streaming example timed out on first run; retried
ci-bot: snippet-tests: passed on retry. markdown-lint: long line in relnotes.md line 14; wrapped
link-bot: linkcheck: found one internal anchor /console/settings#route-config -> 404. Recommend adding redirect to /console/settings#routing. Also flagged external deprecated doc https://thirdparty.example/quant-support -> 410. Convert to inline advisory
marta: updated anchor and removed dead external link, converted compatibility notes inline. added a Known Issues bullet: "Streaming embeddings token offset: legacy quant builds may report token counts off by ~1 token; recommendation: pin variant for sensitive pipelines or re-run evals."
ash: add a short preflight checklist for Dedicated customers: 1) pin variant, 2) run canonical eval set, 3) warm prefix cache, 4) monitor p95 and token-quality metrics for 24h
marta: added checklist and a tiny eval curl example for customers to run a 5-prompt smoke test against pinned variant. Also shortened the changelog blurb to one line for release notes: "Routing: adaptive routing + variant pinning; SDK method remap (see docs)."
lee: LGTM. I'll do a final skim in 10m. Also suggest we post a short note in #support with the migration checklist when live
marta: plan to merge in 10m and schedule publish 09:30 UTC. I'll post to #announcements and #support after release with links and a short migration checklist. Thanks everyone!
